evals.prompt: Create a scratch extraction root with nothing in it yet: SCRATCH=$(mktemp -d). From the repo root, run /metacognition:design woodshop-smoke-test --extractions-root "$SCRATCH". Stop reading the transcript as soon as the first scoping question appears; do not answer it, and do not let the session continue past that point.
evals.expected_output: Preflight states the extraction root in one line and prints the derived domain slug, then the first output that is a question is a single scoping question, the domain-in-one-sentence question from step 1 of the Nine-Step Procedure, asked alone with no second question batched into the same turn; no file is written before that first question is asked.
assertions: before the first question, the transcript states the extraction root in one line and prints the derived domain slug
the first substantive output after those two preflight lines is a question, not a research dispatch, a category map, or a written file
the question matches step 1's first prompt (the domain in one sentence) rather than a later step's question
$SCRATCH/woodshop-smoke-test/interview-spec.md does not exist after the run
$SCRATCH/woodshop-smoke-test/README.md does not exist after the run
the transcript shows no Agent dispatch to metacognition:domain-research before the first question (research is step 2, after scope Q&A opens)
git status --short tests/fixtures/ is empty after the run

evals.prompt: Create a scratch extraction root and an empty skeleton of project notes inside it: SCRATCH=$(mktemp -d); mkdir -p "$SCRATCH/shop-notes/drafts". From the repo root, run /metacognition:design "furniture and jig building in a home shop" --extractions-root "$SCRATCH". Play the person and answer each scoping question in one line, in order: the domain is building furniture for clients and jigs for the shop; the registers are shop and client; the artifacts are the folder "$SCRATCH/shop-notes" and a folder "$SCRATCH/no-such-folder"; the consumer is a skill that advises on joinery choices; no skill exists for this domain. Accept the research list as it stands. Let the session run until it has written its two files, then stop.
evals.expected_output: At the artifact plan step, design checks each local path for existence and real content, records the folder that holds only an empty drafts directory and the folder that does not exist as unavailable with the reason, and tells the person at design time, before the file is written; on a surface with no file access it says in one line that the paths could not be checked. Because both paths are unavailable, artifacts_available is false. The category map carries a Registers column, every register (shop and client) is targeted by at least one category, and a register left untargeted by the first draft is raised with the person before anything is written.
assertions: before interview-spec.md is written, the transcript reports $SCRATCH/shop-notes as unavailable because it holds no real content, or says in one line that the paths could not be checked
before interview-spec.md is written, the transcript reports $SCRATCH/no-such-folder as unavailable because it does not exist, or says in one line that the paths could not be checked
the person is told at design time, in the session, and not only by a line in the written file
the `## Artifact plan` section records each unavailable path as unavailable with a reason, and does not describe either as a source the interview will quote
the `## Category map` table has the columns Category, Maps to generic slot, Floor, Registers, Saturation rule, in that order
every register named in the frontmatter (shop and client) appears in the Registers column of at least one category row
if the first category map left a register untargeted, the transcript shows design raising it with the person (adding questions that target it, or dropping the register) before writing the file
$SCRATCH/shop-notes/drafts is still empty after the run
the transcript shows no taste question put to the person; every question is about the shape of the interview
git status --short tests/fixtures/ is empty after the run
